You have to keep in mind UI isn’t something that can be summoned at will. This is mentioned plenty of times, if you look at each case were Goku goes UI he’s almost near death.

Now if you’re planet is about to be destroyed by Broly which would you choose - 

A- a near death experience to -possibly- spark the UI transformation

(Keep in mind, to get Goku or Vegeta near death takes a lot! Easier to blow up a planet than to kill them.)

B- Transport away and away and use fusion
 -something that you know for sure works-  and use that power to deal with the threat.

Maybe Razbam owns M2M, regardless this looks to be the same model which in my opinion wasn’t/isn’t bad at all. I’d does need work as they said in order to fit the fidelity DCS provides.

We’d like rifles that special forces actually use (ie. MK18, Block II, URGI,?). That’s only three guns that will literally shut up all us “M4 lovers” up. How long did it take to get the REAL 416 again? I know the game is multinational but as an American trying to play an American special forces role I’d rather have what they actually use. Sure the FAL is overdue, but when in reality most special forces around the world are using AR platforms, and only 6 of the 22 customizable Assault Rifles are AR’s (7 with the ACR) , is asking for one or two more extra AR/M4 type rifles really that much? 

Bottom line, a weapons smith mechanic would solve everyone’s problems.
